summary: Terminate the Node-compatible process synchronously with Node exit-event and pending-I/O semantics.

target.notes: This operation is process/event-loop observable and cannot be represented as merely returning from the translated function.

semantics.termination: synchronous forced termination after exit listeners
semantics.default_code: explicit code, else exitCode if set, else 0
semantics.code_types: integer number or integer string; null/undefined use default semantics in modern Node
semantics.worker_threads: terminates the current Worker rather than the whole process when called inside a Worker

caveats: Environment.Exit alone does not reproduce Node 'exit' listeners or Worker behavior.
Do not lower to graceful exitCode assignment; process.exit is intentionally forceful.

tests.name: normal explicit code
tests.expected_behavior: process terminates with status 3 after synchronous exit listeners

tests.name: edge pending output
tests.expected_behavior: Node may terminate before asynchronous stdout writes finish; lowering must not silently wait for all pending I/O
